notes: Card: ' user' x7, ' download' x7, 'Download' x2, ' Download' x2, ' ملف' x2. ' user' was erratic (user-friendly 0.38, 'Every user' 0.01), so I found no shared pattern with ' download' and ' user' is not claimed.
